asset_policy: Keep the four existing explicitly labeled SVG reconstructions. Transcribe numeric tables. Review all appendix figures, but do not claim source-faithful crops when optional raster export was blocked.

decisions.reason: Seven-benchmark headline radial display is less checkable than the transcribed tables.
Similarity and atomic-ability values are summarized with interpretation caveats.
Central one-pass versus continual protocol evidence.
Omni3D sensitivity corroborates the main sweep and is stated numerically.
Five main-text success panels are described without duplicating a dense page.
Six successful-transfer cases are used as existence evidence, not a frequency estimate.
Eight wrong-to-right cases establish the kinds of reference-frame/procedure errors memory can correct.
Five benchmark-side ambiguity panels are central to the evidence boundary and are summarized explicitly.
Three base-model limitation panels show memory cannot replace visual grounding.
Main results, ablations, transfer and additional benchmark values are searchable in Markdown.
Eighteen large image/GT example tables are represented by benchmark-to-subcategory-to-capability mappings and example types.
Exact dataset pools and split counts are essential for reproduction.
Fixed hyperparameters, thresholds and pass-count matrices are summarized exactly.
Prompt roles are summarized and the full templates remain anchored to pp.64-80.

caveat: A representative raster export attempt was blocked by the local command-approval policy. No file was claimed or linked; the PDF remains the source for appendix panels.
